outline.description: Helps readers understand the motivation behind removing tokenization, the challenges it poses, and the high‑level goals of the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT).

outline.description: Explains the three‑part BLT design: the global latent Transformer, the local encoder, and the local decoder. Focuses on how these modules interact to convert raw bytes into latent patches and back.
